source.title: Amendments to the Motions approved - June 2019
source.content:
After recent voting by WCA staff members, the proposed amendments to the Motions have been approved by a good majority. The Motions are effective as of June 1, 2019, and a summary of the included changes has been compiled below:
<!-- break -->
* [Motion 02.2019.1 - Definitions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/02.2019.1%20-%20Definitions.pdf) - Added the definition of Policy and Regional Delegate.
* [Motion 04.2019.1 - Board of Directors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/04.2019.1%20-%20Board%20of%20Directors.pdf) - The right to instate and remove Regional Delegates has been added to the rights of the WCA Board of Directors.
* [Motion 06.2019.1 - Regional Organizations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/06.2019.1%20-%20Regional%20Organizations.pdf) - Added more requirements for the application of a Regional Organization.
* [Motion 09.2019.1 - Senior Delegates](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/09.2019.1%20-%20Senior%20Delegates.pdf) - Added the right to appoint and demote Regional Delegates.
* [Motion 10.2019.0 - Committees and Teams](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2019.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf) - Clarified the conditions for the approval vote to pass when appointing a new Committee/Team Leader.
* [Motion 10.2019.1 - WCA Competition Announcement Team](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2019.1%20-%20Competition%20Announcement%20Team.pdf) - Explicitly link to the “WCA Competition Requirements Policy” and clarify that competition data and metadata can be edited.
* [Motion 10.2019.2 - WCA Disciplinary Committee](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2019.2%20-%20Disciplinary%20Committee.pdf) - Clarified that Registered Speedcubers must cooperate with investigations.
* [Motion 10.2019.3 - WCA Ethics Committee](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2019.3%20-%20Ethics%20Committee.pdf) - Clarified that WCA Staff must abide by the Code of Ethics.
* [Motion 10.2019.4 - WCA Quality Assurance Committee](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2019.4%20-%20Quality%20Assurance%20Committee.pdf) - Changed some definitions and procedure to better define the scope of the WQAC.
* [Motion 11.2019.1 - Finances of the WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/11.2019.1%20-%20Finances.pdf) - Modified the details regarding the auditing of the finances and added the details of filing the returns.

Along with the above changes, two new Motions have been added:
* [Motion 09.2019.2 - Regional Delegates](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/09.2019.2%20-%20Regional%20Delegates.pdf)
* [Motion 10.2019.5 - Data Protection Committee](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2019.5%20-%20Data%20Protection%20Committee.pdf)

translation.title: WCA 决议修订获通过（2019 年 6 月）
translation.content:
经 WCA 工作人员近期投票，决议修订提案以明显多数通过。这些决议自 2019 年 6 月 1 日起生效，主要改动如下：
<!-- break -->
* [决议 02.2019.1——定义](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/02.2019.1%20-%20Definitions.pdf) - 增加“政策”和“区域代表”的定义。
* [决议 04.2019.1——董事会](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/04.2019.1%20-%20Board%20of%20Directors.pdf) - 在 WCA 董事会的权限中增加任命和免除区域代表的权利。
* [决议 06.2019.1——地区组织](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/06.2019.1%20-%20Regional%20Organizations.pdf) - 增加申请成为地区组织的要求。
* [决议 09.2019.1——高级代表](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/09.2019.1%20-%20Senior%20Delegates.pdf) - 增加任命区域代表和将其降级的权利。
* [决议 10.2019.0——委员会与团队](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2019.0%20-%20Committees%20and%20Teams.pdf) - 明确任命新委员会/团队负责人时，确认投票的通过条件。
* [决议 10.2019.1——WCA 比赛公示组](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2019.1%20-%20Competition%20Announcement%20Team.pdf) - 明确链接至《WCA 比赛要求政策》，并明确比赛数据及元数据可以编辑。
* [决议 10.2019.2——WCA 纪律委员会](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2019.2%20-%20Disciplinary%20Committee.pdf) - 明确注册速拧选手必须配合调查。
* [决议 10.2019.3——WCA 道德委员会](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2019.3%20-%20Ethics%20Committee.pdf) - 明确 WCA 工作人员必须遵守《道德准则》。
* [决议 10.2019.4——WCA 质量保证委员会](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2019.4%20-%20Quality%20Assurance%20Committee.pdf) - 调整部分定义和流程，更清楚地界定 WQAC 的职责范围。
* [决议 11.2019.1——WCA 财务](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/11.2019.1%20-%20Finances.pdf) - 修改财务审计相关细节，并补充报税申报的具体规定。

除上述改动外，还新增了两份决议：
* [决议 09.2019.2——区域代表](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/09.2019.2%20-%20Regional%20Delegates.pdf)
* [决议 10.2019.5——数据保护委员会](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/10.2019.5%20-%20Data%20Protection%20Committee.pdf)
